visual_review: Sampled all seven source clips and inspected the selected photographs. Reviewed both tattooing clips at one-second intervals to select a continuous hands-and-forearm excerpt without large customer face closeups. All clips show continuous real-looking shop activity with no obvious generated imagery. Selection is based on visible content and original public-site provenance, not a forensic authenticity certification.
limitations: The selected tattooing source is only 498 by 246 pixels. It is suitable for a dimmed motion backdrop, not a sharp full-screen hero.
The original homepage embed is instead a 496 by 892 portrait clip of Ink Roulette and the shop tour.
The sharper source storefront photograph is available as an alternative static hero image.
